methods.title: Grasp Pose Generator / geometric portion of High Precision Grasp Pose Detection in Dense Clutter
methods.training: Geometric generator is training-free; full GPD classification must be distinguished.
methods.input: 3D point cloud and normals; CAD-sampled input is an adapter choice.
methods.generation: Local frames, hand rotations, feasible finger placements and deeper insertion of fingers.
methods.reduction: No universal 12-grasp shortlist established by this source.
methods.shared_region: Transverse Y/Z bounding-interval overlap plus >=12 normal-qualified samples per side in shared rectangle; not exact projected polygon intersection.

methods.title: Rigid Grasp Candidate Generation for Assembly Tasks
methods.input: Triangle mesh STL and gripper dimensions.
methods.evaluation: Author release targets furniture assembly; no NIST-object evaluation verified.
methods.generation: Geometry mode samples offset lines near triangle edges and ray/plane pairs opposing surfaces; random surface mode also supplied.
methods.reduction: Reject gripper/target collisions and width failures, then pose distance/angle duplicate suppression.
methods.shared_region: No exact local shared-pad polygon check found in inspected generator.
methods.caveat: Furniture-scale sampling parameters must be converted/adapted to our meter-native small parts; this is not proof default code handles round NIST pins.

methods.title: Fabrica: Dual-Arm Assembly of General Multi-Part Objects via Integrated Planning and Learning
methods.training: Grasp-generation stage analytic; full contact-rich assembly controller uses learning.
methods.input: Full triangle meshes; Panda gripper supported.
methods.evaluation: General multi-part assembly; no NIST task-board evaluation verified.
dependencies: project helpers; additional full-stack dependencies excluded from leaf-only claim
methods.generation: Random surface points, inward normal rays, opposing-normal dot>0.95, ground/contact-clearance sphere checks, rotation around contact-pair axis.
methods.reduction: KD-tree sparsity on both pair endpoints, midpoint-to-mesh-centroid ordering; optional final cap randomly subsamples feasible grasps.
methods.separate_sequence_score: Lexicographic supported holding (maximize), grasp switches (minimize), moving-part torque proxy (minimize), relative hand angle times holding contact count (maximize). Torque proxy uses CAD contact positions, COM and normalized disassembly direction; not measured in-hand or assembly precision.
methods.shared_region: No exact shared-pad polygon overlap in inspected leaf.
caveats: Asset-scale defaults such as clearance=1.0 and ray inset=0.05 cannot be interpreted as meters in our scene.
Pair generation has an unbounded while loop and a no-pairs TODO; a bounded adapter must disclose that change.
Whole-framework installation and RL training are not necessary to read/adapt analytic leaf, but no leaf execution occurred in literature subtask.

methods.title: EmbodiChain GraspKit parallel-gripper mesh generation
methods.training: Geometric leaf; does not require trained grasp model.
methods.evaluation: Documented mug tutorial; NIST performance not established.
dependencies: EmbodiChain leaf config/logger helpers; full simulator dependencies must be separated
methods.generation: Contact-pair sampling, requested-approach pose construction, collision filtering and ranking.
methods.reduction: Ranking and requested candidate count; exact source revision owns behavior.
methods.version_caveat: v0.2.4 documentation says uniform surface sampling; inspected current main uses Fibonacci rays toward mesh center. Do not combine claims from different versions.

methods.title: Dex-Net analytic AntipodalGraspSampler
methods.training: Analytic sampler training-free; learned GQ-CNN scoring is separate.
methods.license: UC Berkeley educational, research and not-for-profit permission; commercial license separately referenced by copyright header.
dependencies: OpenRAVE optional import in inspected sampler
methods.generation: Surface contact and friction-cone axis rejection sampling, second-contact construction, finger-close contact search and force-closure check.
methods.reduction: Grasp-distance coverage pruning, shuffle and truncate target count.
methods.shared_region: Point-contact friction/force-closure model; no exact shared finite-pad polygon check.

methods.title: GraspIt! geometric grasp planning
methods.training: Analytic search without grasp-model training; database planners are separate.
methods.license: GPL-3.0-or-later; third-party components have their own notices.
methods.generation: General EigenGrasp search uses simulated annealing over posture/pose and contact energies. Separate primitive planner uses shape-rule starting grasps.
methods.caveat: Old documented primitive planner is Barrett-only; general EigenGrasp planners are not restricted to that primitive pipeline.

methods.title: MoveIt Grasps
methods.evaluation: Blocks/cylinders, not an arbitrary BNC/gear mesh generator.
methods.generation: Multiple approach directions and primitive-based grasp poses.
methods.caveat: README explicitly excludes friction-cone and dynamics modeling.

methods.title: Automatic Grasp Pose Generation for Parallel Jaw Grippers
methods.input: CAD/scan surface point cloud and normals.
methods.evaluation: Qualitative IPAGearShaft/IPARingScrew/IPAUBolt/SileaneGear; physical ring-screw bin picking, not NIST Task Board.
methods.generation: Point pairs filtered by finger travel, friction and simplified cuboid collision geometry; discretize remaining rotation around pair axis.
methods.reduction: Two-stage PAM k-medoids over translation and normalized closing direction, preserving real candidate medoids.
caveats: Explicitly offline, generation seconds/minutes and clustering minutes/hours in paper.
Simplified hand collision model; paper says full gripper integration is future work.
Do not represent a local port as original released implementation.

methods.title: Pickalo: Leveraging 6D Pose Estimation for Low-Cost Industrial Bin Picking
methods.training: CAD grasp generation analytic; complete perception stack uses trained models.
methods.evaluation: Square/cylindrical/complex metallic industrial components with UR5e parallel jaw, not NIST board.
methods.license: No released complete grasp-generator source/license verified from paper/project.
methods.generation: Offline normal-ray antipodal candidates, outward approach perpendicular to closing axis, CAD finger/part collision check; optional manual refinement.
methods.reduction: Runtime weighted vertical alignment, wrist yaw, pose confidence and height utility, followed by collision/IK check on top fraction.
methods.caveat: Offline curated grasp database does not satisfy user's preferred on-demand candidate generation without adaptation.

methods.title: Towards Robotic Assembly by Predicting Robust, Precise and Task-oriented Grasps
methods.training: Three cascaded trained networks; excluded as training-free replacement.
methods.evaluation: Gear-on-peg, bracket and slot assembly; no NIST task-board claim verified.
methods.license: No implementation license verified in this review.

nist_context.evidence: 76 objects from NIST ATB1-4; CAD and reconstructed assets; no grasp generation implementation verified.

nist_context.kind: VLA assembly benchmark, not geometric candidate generator
nist_context.evidence: 14 ATB1-style pin, gear and nut tasks, Robotiq2F85; pegs start upright in presentation bores, gears/nuts flat; no BNC tasks listed.

local_vs_upstream.local_rule: Exact projected finite-pad polygon intersection in 25 micrometer band.
local_vs_upstream.attribution: Added local rule; do not attribute exact implementation to Wan or GPG.
local_vs_upstream.gpg_difference: 3mm extremal band and transverse bounding-rectangle sample support, not exact polygon overlap.
local_vs_upstream.interpretation: Wider upstream support is motivation for controlled ablation; availability alone is not pickup or assembly precision.
